geometry.population: unique legal identity/tick in this visit selected anchors commit12
geometry.allocation: proportional stage population with one per nonempty stage when feasible
geometry.rounding: ceil population/2; stage floor then largest remaining proportional deficit
geometry.reduction: mean selected unique configurations; no additional stage weights
geometry.rng: explicit independent CPU generator per visit; never model/diffusion RNG
geometry.labels: recorded diagnostic phases for sampling only; never network inputs
